description: This file is an Alembic migration script that modifies database schema to replace integer ID columns with UUIDs across 'user' and 'item' tables, including creating extensions, adding new columns, populating UUIDs, and handling constraints.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema migration to replace integer IDs with UUIDs, including creating extensions, adding columns, populating UUIDs, and updating constraints.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the schema changes by restoring integer ID columns and constraints.
